card.title: Paragraph Writing — topic sentence, cohesion, exam format

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: **What it is:** ONE controlling idea in 4–6 sentences — the engine behind every essay, letter and report.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
**Structure:** (1) *Topic sentence* — main idea + your angle, specific not generic. (2) *Supporting sentences* — each adds ONE fact/example/reason, logically ordered.…
**Unity test:** if a sentence could belong to another paragraph, delete it. **Coherence test:** the reader follows without re-reading — via connectors and repeated key words.

rows.label: Hints
rows.text: **Structure:** (1) *Topic sentence* — main idea + your angle, specific not generic. (2) *Supporting sentences* — each adds ONE fact/example/reason, logically ordered. (3) *Concluding sentence* — restates or lands a consequence; no new ideas here.
